actual:
{"format.gif": "Could not analyze

title: Network loss during an image check
expected: an error such as 'Cannot reach the backend at …' (no crash, no endless spinner); retry works once online
actual: connection dropped (1 request failed with ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED) -> ['Could not analyze\n\nCannot reach the backend at http://127.0.0.1:8001. Check the API URL and that FastAPI is running.']; button busy afterwards False; connection back, retry -> Image authenticity. Note: switching the whole browser offline instead also blocks the Expo DEV server, which loads the result screen's code lazily (app/result/[id].bundle?lazy=true), so the dev web app shows 'Something went wrong / Failed to fetch' (screenshot MC-21_diag_offline.png); a built app and Expo Go do not load screens that way
how: Emulated (the image upload's connection failed with ERR_INTERNET_DISCONNECTED mid-request)

title: Background and return during a Roman Urdu check

actual: after 20 s frozen: Why this result at /result/25; still signed in True; history 10 -> 11
how: Emulated (page frozen 20 s with the browser lifecycle API)
